copy.headline: Georgia AG encourages SEC to take 'action' vs. LSU, 'including expulsion'
copy.caption: The Georgia Attorney General blasted LSU in a letter to SEC commissioner Greg Sankey, encouraging sanctions against the Tigers, "up to and including expulsion."
